senses.gloss:
ITA-1.9.4.1.4 rūpaḥ रूपः
Visual form, colour
Trait of fire element.

ITA-4.5.5 linga लिङ्गः, आकृतिः , लक्षणम् , चिह्नम् , संस्थानम् , व्यञ्जनम् , रूपम् .
Signs and symptoms
Ayurveda uses several terms as synonyms for signs and symptoms, based on the different perspectives under which they are understood. Any morbid phenomenon or departure from the normal in structure, function or sensation, as experienced by the patient or observed by the physician and indicating a disease. The terms used are लिङ्गः, आकृतिः , लक्षणम् , चिह्नम् , संस्थानम् , व्यञ्जनम् , रूपम् .

ITA-3.15.4 Rūpavahādhamanī रूपवहाधमनी
Artery related to perception of form
